core_theme: Agent 的 token 成本由模型外的 Harness 运行时上下文和调用方式共同决定
reader_takeaway: 理解延迟加载、结果卸载、子代理、Code Mode 与上下文压缩如何减少重复上下文
summary_angle: Agent 成本高时，真正需要先检查的是运行时如何搬运上下文，而不是只更换模型

information_blocks.source_anchor: Why the same task can cost three times more：50,000 token 结果在 16 次调用中被重复读取
information_blocks.visual_idea: 一条输入模型的长数据流在运行时被分流，重复搬运形成沉重尾部

information_blocks.source_anchor: What TrueForge loads before the run starts 与 What happens during the run：按需发现工具、卸载大结果、子代理隔离、Code Mode
information_blocks.visual_idea: 中心 Harness 管道连接四个轻量分支：延迟加载、文件卸载、子代理、代码处理

information_blocks.source_anchor: Benchmarks：TrueForge 与 Claude Managed Agents 使用同一模型时分别为 3.7M 与 10.0M token
information_blocks.visual_idea: 同一条任务流在右侧汇聚为短而清晰的 token 流，强调运行时带来的差异

information_blocks.source_anchor: Why the sandbox never holds your credentials：凭据留在 Harness，沙箱处理代码与文件

final_prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: wide cover illustration for a Chinese technology blog article. Primary request: create a wide 2.35:1 editorial architecture illustration explaining why an AI agent can spend too many tokens and how an Agent Harness reduces repeated context. Theme: token cost is shaped by the runtime layer around the model. Reader takeaway: delayed loading, large-result offloading, subagent isolation, Code Mode, and compaction keep the model context smaller and protect credentials. Summary angle: when an agent is expensive, inspect how the runtime carries context before changing the model. Narrative flow: layered reveal. Main subject: one dominant isometric Harness control tower surrounding a small model-loop core, routing a large noisy data stream through several controlled paths. Left side: an oversized tangled stream labeled only with the short Chinese chip 重复上下文 and the number chip 50K, showing repeated payload weight. Center: the Harness tower with a few clean, abstract modules, one short Chinese chip 按需加载, and small numbered markers 1 2 3 4 for source-grounded mechanisms. Right side: a shorter organized summary stream with the chip 2.7×, visually showing less repeated material. A small locked credential symbol stays on the server side while a separate sandbox module handles files and code, labeled 凭据隔离. Composition: one focal tower in isometric space, horizontal left-to-right flow, 2-4 supporting narrative beats, generous negative space, readable wide layout. Style/medium: combine isometric conceptual systems scene with warm hand-drawn animation feeling, natural environments, gentle fantasy everyday mood, soft painterly backgrounds, no studio imitation. Use mature editorial clarity, restrained detail, soft paper texture, deep blue-gray, warm cream, teal green, and muted orange accents. Visible text policy: allow only the four approved short Chinese labels 重复上下文, 按需加载, 2.7×, 凭据隔离, plus the number 50K and markers 1 2 3 4; no poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans. Constraints: one clear focal subject, source-grounded conceptual relationships, no real product screenshot, no dashboard, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names, no fabricated metrics beyond 50K and 2.7×, no watermark, no prompt residue, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter, no floating chips, no code rain, no generic robot, no excessive HUD, no imitation of a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
